title: An unbiased comparison of 14 epigenetic clocks in relation to 10-year onset of 174 disease outcomes in 18,859 individuals

fields.title: An unbiased comparison of 14 epigenetic clocks in relation to 10-year onset of 174 disease outcomes in 18,859 individuals
fields.authors: Mavrommatis, C., Belsky, D., Ying, K., Moqri, M., Campbell, A., Richmond, A., ..., Gladyshev, V. N.
fields.description: This preprint compared 14 epigenetic clocks with 174 incident diseases and all-cause mortality. Second-generation clocks outperformed first-generation clocks, and adding clock measures improved risk classification for some outcomes beyond traditional risk factors.

descriptions.text: This preprint compared 14 epigenetic clocks with 174 incident diseases and all-cause mortality. Second-generation clocks outperformed first-generation clocks, and adding clock measures improved risk classification for some outcomes beyond traditional risk factors.

pdfFigures.legendFirstSentence: Comparison of epigenetic clock effect sizes across 174 incident disease outcomes.
Signiﬁcant clock-disease associations with AUC improvements > 1%.
